intelligenceLoop.title: A Proven 4-Step Career Acceleration Engine
intelligenceLoop.subtitle: Built specifically for African youths, university graduates, TVET trainees, and professionals navigating local and global markets.

step1.title: 1. Multi-Dimensional Assessment
step1.desc: Input your educational background, current practical skills, constraints, and interests across 12 African economic sectors.

step2.title: 2. Localized Market Matching
step2.desc: Receive ranked career recommendations benchmarked to real salary rates, verified employers, and demand across your chosen African country.

step3.title: 3. Precise Skill Gap Diagnosis
step3.desc: Identify exact technical, soft, and vocational skill gaps with African and global free learning resources, weekly estimates, and milestones.

step4.title: 4. 90-Day Execution Roadmap
step4.desc: Follow a weekly milestone-driven execution plan, generate ATS-optimized CVs, and apply directly to verified local and remote jobs.

sectors.title: Explore Africa's Booming Industries

regional.subtitle: Compare salaries, key tech & industrial hubs, and top employers from Banjul and Dakar to Lagos, Nairobi, and Kigali.
